critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, automated scans report no confirmed WCAG violations, no viewport overflow, and no touch-target violations. However, mandate color contrast remains unresolved with serious incomplete results on 28 desktop nodes and 37 tablet/mobile nodes, including headings, explanatory text, status badges, flow nodes, and chart labels. No measured keyboard-navigation or reduced-motion evidence was provided, so demo readiness cannot be established.
critique.fix: Resolve and verify contrast against the actual gradient/overlapped backgrounds, including chart and flow text. Add measured keyboard-only testing for focus order, visible focus, operability, and traps—especially the React Flow nodes/controls and mismatch control. Test with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce and confirm that nonessential transitions or graph motion are disabled.
